{{Quotation|game|Used as a training facility for the [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|Ascalon]] army, Fort Ranik houses new recruits. Here, soldiers learn what it takes to be one of Ascalon's finest and bravest, and how to use their talents to defeat the enemy. Fort Ranik is one of the best-equipped strongholds in the kingdom.}}

[[Fort Ranik (pre-Searing)|Fort Ranik]] is a fort in relative peace within Ascalon, as it is away from the [[Great Northern Wall]] and the [[Charr]] assaults. However, the path to the fort is covered with [[Royalist]]s and [[Skale]]s.

== Getting there ==
While the [[quest]] [[The True King]] will lead players here, one can reach Fort Ranik by heading directly southeast through [[Regent Valley (pre-Searing)|Regent Valley]] from [[Lakeside County]]. The path from said exit leads to Fort Ranik.
